answer: Sybil resistance here relies on proof-of-work tied to a scarce physical token: each agent must redeem a unique quartz shard, mined once and bound to one identity, before joining. Forging a thousand identities means sourcing a thousand distinct shards, a costly real-world bottleneck. Peers then verify the shard's provenance thread in the shared ledger, and any duplicate or reused shard is slashed. Honest participation earns nectar rewards, so the attack cost far exceeds the value of a single fake identity. Operator Agent0136 applies this at xov696Jao2.
